steps.title: Check Your Eligibility
steps.body: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page Connect your wallet Click “Verify Now” to view your status If your results appear incorrect, contact the AIW3 support team to request a manual review.

steps.title: Visit the AIW3 airdrop page
steps.body: Go to the AIW3 airdrop page and open the Airdrop tab. This is where your points, tasks, and ranking live.

steps.title: Connect your wallet and complete the tutorial
steps.body: Connect your wallet and then finish the onboarding tutorial on the Airdrop tab. Wallet binding is required for the snapshot, so do this before July 28.

steps.title: Check in daily
steps.body: Hit the check-in button every day. Rewards follow a 7-day cycle that climbs from 3 points on day 1 to 10 points on day 7, and missing a day does not reset your progress.

steps.title: Complete the community tasks
steps.body: Follow AIW3 on X, repost the featured campaign post, and join the AIW3 Telegram from the airdrop page. These one-time tasks pay 10 to 20 points each and take about two minutes.

steps.title: Make daily predictions
steps.body: Complete at least one prediction market entry per day for 20 points. Three predictions in a day pays 50 points, and inviting a friend who completes a prediction adds another 30. The prediction tasks reset daily, so they compound fast for consistent users.

steps.title: Trade on the platform
steps.body: You earn points for every 1,000 USDT in trading volume, plus milestone bonuses for consistent activity. You can grab USDT or SOL on Bybit , and if your funds sit on another chain, the widget below moves them over to Solana or BNB Chain in one transaction. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

steps.title: Publish AI strategies
steps.body: Create trading strategies and publish them to the Strategy Square. Strategy rewards are repeatable, so this suits users who want points without constant manual activity.

steps.title: Refer friends
steps.body: Share your referral link from the airdrop page. Referrals earn bonus points when invited users stay active, and they stack with the daily prediction invite task.

steps.title: Verify eligibility and claim
steps.body: Check the eligibility page from July 29, then claim your tokens when TGE goes live on August 3.

items.description: The AIW3 Genesis Airdrop eligibility checker opened July 29, letting you verify whether your address qualifies based on the July 28 snapshot. The checker displays snapshot eligibility, wallet verification status, and initial airdrop qualification.

items.name: Onchain Cc
items.tagline: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions,

steps.title: Visit Onchain.cc
steps.body: Head to the Onchain.cc terminal and click “Start trading” on the landing page.

steps.title: Authenticate with Privy
steps.body: Sign in using one of the supported methods: Email — Privy creates an embedded non-custodial wallet for you. Google account — same flow as email, signed in with Gmail. External EVM wallet — connect MetaMask, Rabby, or another EVM wallet. Privy handles key management without holding your funds, so you keep custody throughout.

steps.title: Fund Your Wallets
steps.body: Open the wallet menu in the top right to see your Solana and EVM addresses. Ensure you have USDC, SOL, or ETH in your wallet. If you don’t have any, you can get them from Binance or swap and bridge funds directly using the widget below.

steps.title: Place Your First Trade
steps.body: Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab Three discovery paths feed into the same trading panel: Degen Feed (Trenches): Solana-only memecoin discovery with trending tokens and new launches. Contract address search: paste any token’s CA into the search bar to load its chart directly. Discover tab: filter by volume, market cap, or other criteria to find trending markets. Set your size, check the slippage estimate, and submit. Points accrue automatically based on your volume and any session multipliers active at the time.

steps.title: Climb the Colosseum Leaderboard
steps.body: Open the Colosseum tab to see the active season, current session timer, and any live Bonus Windows. Trading during a Bonus Window (typically 2x or 3x points for a few hours) is the fastest way to push your session rank.

steps.title: Earn Points from X Posts
steps.body: Onchain.cc runs a social scoring system that pays Colosseum points for posting about the platform on X. Tag the official @Onchaincc account so the AI scorer picks up your post. Quality, reach, and engagement determine the score on a 0–100 scale. Posts that share a real trade, include a screenshot of the terminal, or generate organic engagement score well. Spam and copy-paste content score near zero.

steps.title: Trade Perps on Hyperliquid Markets
steps.body: Switch to the perps tab to trade Hyperliquid’s 300+ markets from the same interface. Perp volume feeds into your Colosseum points the same way spot volume does, often with higher leverage and tighter spreads. Check funding rates before opening leveraged positions.

steps.title: Stack Sessions and Refer Friends
steps.body: Sessions reset weekly, each with its own leaderboard and USDC prize pool. Daily and weekly quests sit alongside the leaderboard, adding points and prize pool entries on top of your trading activity. You can also refer your friends to earn more points.

items.description: The Onchain.cc team has not confirmed a native token or token airdrop. The platform’s Colosseum points system, sessions, and seasonal leaderboards point toward a possible retroactive reward for early traders, similar to how other trading terminals have rewarded volume contributors before launching a token.

items.tagline: Fireplace is closing down, with the site going dark for good after September 30, 2026 at 23:59 UTC. Anyone holding an op
items.description: Fireplace is closing down, with the site going dark for good after September 30, 2026 at 23:59 UTC. Anyone holding an open position or cash balance on the platform needs to act before then. No positions get automatically liquidated, but once the deadline passes, there’s no way to retrieve anything.

items.name: Voice
items.tagline: The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE dist

steps.title: Visit the VOICE Social Camp
steps.body: Go to the VOICE Social Camp page. This is the pre-launch hub where quests, leaderboards, and CLOUT tracking live.

steps.title: Sign in with your X account
steps.body: Connect your X account, since most quests track posts, quotes, and mentions there. You can also continue with a Google account or a Solana wallet.

steps.title: Complete Core, Daily, and Burst tasks
steps.body: Clear the Core tasks first, then return for the Daily set. Burst tasks are shorter, higher-value entries announced in the VOICE Discord , so keep an eye there for drops.

steps.title: Vote in polls and Opinion Cup battles
steps.body: Cast votes on active polls and in Opinion Cup matchups. Each vote earns CLOUT, and the Cup runs creator battles with USDT prize pools on top.

steps.title: Join the Voice Pulse campaign
steps.body: Enter the Voice Pulse campaign for extra CLOUT and rewards. This round closes on September 1, so finish its tasks before the deadline.

steps.title: Complete the Layer3 VOICE campaign
steps.body: Head to the separate VOICE campaign on Layer3 , which carries an advertised $2,000 reward pool. Complete the listed quests to qualify for a share.

steps.title: Enter partner clusters
steps.body: Join the partner clusters inside Social Camp. These bundle quests from partner projects and carry their own USDT and NFT pools alongside CLOUT.

steps.title: Invite friends through FRENS
steps.body: Share your FRENS invite link. You earn a permanent 10% boost on the CLOUT your invitees generate, so early invites keep paying through the rest of the campaign.

items.description: The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE distribution to activity: CLOUT earned in Social Camp hard-syncs to your profile, and the tiers list a base $VOICE airdrop allocation, whitelist access, NFT drops, and early access at the higher levels.

items.name: Kryvora Network
items.tagline: The Kryvora Network airdrop is confirmed and runs on points. Testers earn PTS through onchain, social, daily, and node t

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to the Tasks Portal
steps.body: Open the Kryvora Quests & Points Portal and connect an EVM wallet. Add Kryvora Network to your wallet when prompted (Chain ID 73829164).

steps.title: Claim a Daily Check-In
steps.body: Check in on the portal for +50 PTS. Daily check-ins build your streak, so return every day.

steps.title: Link Your Socials and Join Discord
steps.body: Connect your X and Discord accounts, then complete the social quests: Follow, repost, and quote @KryvoraNetwork on X Join the Kryvora Discord server For tips on earning server roles, see our Discord role farming guide .

steps.title: Get Testnet ETH
steps.body: Request test ETH from the Kryvora faucet . You can also bridge Sepolia ETH to the Kryvora testnet.

steps.title: Complete Onchain Tasks
steps.body: Go to the Kryvora dApps page and work through the onchain quests: Swap tokens Add liquidity to a pool Supply assets to the lending market Deploy a smart contract

steps.title: Mint a Testnet NFT
steps.body: Visit the Kryvora NFT page and mint a Nuke Genesis or Verdant Core NFT to complete the NFT quest.

steps.title: Invite Friends
steps.body: Share your referral link from the portal. Three active invites earn +200 PTS.

steps.title: Run a Genesis Node (Optional)
steps.body: This is the only paid step. A Genesis Node Key costs about 10 USDC on Arbitrum and can be minted at the Kryvora Node page . After minting, self-host the node or use the 1-click cloud option on Node Hub . You can buy USDC on Bybit . If your funds sit on another chain, move them to Arbitrum with the widget below. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains without leaving this page. Fast routes, low fees. Bridge now Opens an interactive bridge widget Open the bridge in a new tab

items.description: The Kryvora Network airdrop is confirmed and runs on points. Testers earn PTS through onchain, social, daily, and node tasks, and the team has published a fixed conversion of 100 PTS to 1 $KRV. The TGE date has not been announced.

items.name: Ritual
items.tagline: There hasn’t been any news about an official airdrop. There is no confirmed $RITUAL token, ticker, or way to get it. Tha

steps.title: Join the Ritual Discord
steps.body: Go to Ritual’s Discord and complete onboarding. You’ll need a verified Discord account. The Discord is where roles are assigned and where testnet access is gated.

steps.title: Complete Community Quests
steps.body: Visit the Ritual quest portal and log in with your Discord account. Complete available tasks to earn XP and role upgrades. Current quest categories include: Social tasks Discord engagement and invites Pledge section submissions (if open — submit unique text when active)

steps.title: Earn and Upgrade Discord Roles
steps.body: You can move up in your role by being active on Discord. The team keeps track of roles like Ritualist, Zealot, Summoner, Radiant Ritualist, and Pledged to Synful. Higher roles give you priority access to the testnet. Keep an eye on channels and announcements for tasks that are specific to your role.

items.description: There hasn’t been any news about an official airdrop. There is no confirmed $RITUAL token, ticker, or way to get it. That being said, the project has active community programs like Discord role quests and ambassador activities that are similar to how projects that later rewarded contributors got people involved in the beginning.

items.name: Vibe Vibe
items.tagline: Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, an

steps.title: Claim Test ETH from the Faucet
steps.body: Open the Robinhood Chain Testnet Faucet , enter your wallet address, and request test ETH. You need it for gas and for trading on the testnet.

steps.title: Connect Your Wallet to Vibe Vibe
steps.body: Go to the Vibe Vibe testnet and connect your EVM wallet. If your wallet asks you to add or switch to Robinhood Chain Testnet, approve it.

steps.title: Create a Testnet Token
steps.body: Click the launch option and fill in the details: Token name and ticker Token image (required) A short description of the project Put some effort into it, because the team says quality launches count.

steps.title: Buy and Sell Testnet Tokens
steps.body: Trade tokens launched by other users. Buy early on the bonding curve and sell into strength, since high PnL is one of the listed eligibility criteria.

steps.title: Join the Telegram Raiding Channel
steps.body: Join the Vibe Vibe Telegram and take part in raids on X. You need a verified X account, and the top 250 raiders qualify for a free Vibe Vibers NFT.

steps.title: Apply for a Vibe Vibers Whitelist
steps.body: Follow the Vibe Vibers page for mint updates. Creators who make memes or other content can apply for collab spots when the form opens, with free mint whitelists awarded based on quality.

items.description: Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, and active users are the groups named as eligible. The allocation is discretionary: the team can exclude sybil and wash-trading wallets, and testnet points or leaderboard positions do not guarantee a reward.

items.name: Yakkamon
items.tagline: The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Mon

steps.title: Sign Up at Yakkamon
steps.body: Create your account with an email address on the Yakkamon pre-registration page . No wallet is needed at this stage. Enter the referral code YAKKA-52UCFU during sign-up.

steps.title: Nurture Your Egg Daily
steps.body: Tap your egg three times each day for +6 points. Daily streaks add bonuses, and a missed day resets the streak.

steps.title: Connect Discord and X
steps.body: Link your Discord and X accounts for +10 points each. Helpful posts in the Discord earn extra points through community reactions, and the weekly share quest pays +20 points per week once X is connected.

steps.title: Link and Verify a Wallet
steps.body: Connect a wallet and sign a message to prove ownership for +10 points. A verified wallet is also required for the free mint whitelist, so complete this well before October 1, 2026.

steps.title: Refer Friends
steps.body: Each verified friend who joins earns you +30 points. Your first five referrals count instantly; after that, invitees must verify Discord and X and reach 100 points before the bonus lands. Multi-accounting gets filtered out on review.

steps.title: Mint the Free Monster NFT on October 1
steps.body: Join the free mint of 10,000 Monster NFTs on Ronin using your verified wallet. It costs nothing beyond a small gas fee, is limited to one mint per trainer, and minting adds points to your leaderboard total.

steps.title: Mint Your Yakkamon NFT
steps.body: Check which waves your Ronin wallet qualifies for on the whitelist checker Deposit 5 $FLOWER if you’re minting in Wave 2 or Wave 4 (see the $FLOWER deposit guide ) Connect your Ronin wallet to the Ronin Launchpad when your wave opens and mint, keeping some RON for gas

items.description: The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Monster NFTs when early access launches: ranks 1 to 1,000 get Legendary Monster NFTs and ranks 1,001 to 5,000 get Rare Monster NFTs. Distribution is automatic and based purely on points, never on sign-up order. The same leaderboard decides early access, with the top 100,000 trainers entering in waves.
